summary: A bank-ready business plan as a PDF: cover, an executive summary with key figures, business, market, operations, staff, financing, financial tables whose totals and shares code computes only from the customer’s own figures, risks, conclusion and a signature line; every fact the customer did not give is a ruled blank, never an invented name, number, date or source.
tone: formal, impersonal business prose; third person; plans in present or future tense; short sentences; no advertising adjectives; every claim traceable to the customer’s message or attached files
title: model

length.note: A count paper (the architecture’s page rule count) with every written part grounded, so a top-up has nothing it may extend and fill is off; the facts set how full the pages are.

prompt.ru: 💰 Напишите цифры: на что сколько пойдёт, собственные средства и кредит (ставка, срок), цена продукции и объём в месяц, ежемесячные расходы, число сотрудников и оклад. Что не напишете, в плане будет пустой строкой.
prompt.en: 💰 Write the figures: what the money buys and how much, your own funds and the loan (rate, term), product prices and monthly volumes, monthly costs, staff numbers and pay. Anything you leave out is a blank line in the plan.

parts.write: Drawn from the facts. The document title you return is a plain name of the project, at most 160 characters: no slogan, quotation marks or adjective the customer did not use.
Nothing: drawn by the template.

The opening of the executive summary, written last, four or five sentences: what the business is, where, what it needs and from whom, and the loan, grant or investment in the customer’s own words (yillik 24%, 3 yil). Only figures the customer wrote; no fact another part does not state. Phrased for the purpose: bank loan, grant, investor or the owner’s own plan.
Nothing: key figures drawn from the facts and the investment table.
Nothing: rows drawn from the facts; a missing value is a ruled blank.
One or two sentences on what the plan is for. Promise only what the plan holds: no repayment schedule and no profit forecast are drawn this round, so never promise either.
One or two sentences on where the project stands (premises, permits, quotes), only from the customer’s words. Empty when nothing was said.

What the business does, where, for whom, its legal form, whether it is new or operating, and the founder’s experience if given. Third person, three to five sentences. Never an invented history, award, licence, partner, goal or number of years.

One row per product or service the customer priced, in their order: label the name, then the unit (only if given), and the price last, exactly as written. A price not given stays empty. No price at all: no rows, and the products are named in the business description.

Who buys and how the goods or services reach them, in one to three sentences, from the message. No statistic, market size, growth, ranking, season or trend unless the customer or a file gave it; a market figure is given with the source the customer named.

Two or more competitors or groups the customer named: one row each, label the competitor, the customer’s own comment last. Never add a strength, weakness, group or name the customer did not give. Fewer than two named: no rows.

Two or three items, each built on a customer fact: label one of price, sales or promotion, text one or two sentences in the plan’s future tense (rejalashtiriladi). Price refers to the products table and names no new price; sales names the channels the customer named; promotion names a budget only as given. Fewer than two such facts: no items.

How the work is done day to day, only as the customer described it: premises (own or rented, area, address), capacity or working days, the equipment of the investment table. Never a made-up capacity, shift pattern, supplier or supplier type. Empty when the customer said nothing beyond the other parts.

One row per position the customer named: label the position, then the number of people and the monthly pay as given, and leave the last cell empty (code multiplies). Only an average pay: one row Xodimlar with the number and the average. No pay given: no rows, and the number of staff is a sentence of the operations.

Stage rows only from the customer’s own items (each investment line, hiring, the launch; registration and permits only for a new business) in the order they happen: label the stage, then its start and its duration as given. Only when the customer gave at least one duration or start and there are three rows or more; never mark a stage done unless the customer said so.

One row per thing the money buys, in the customer’s order: label the item, then the quantity and the unit price when given, and the amount last. Leave the amount empty when quantity and price are given (code multiplies); a line with only an amount carries it in the amount. Code adds the total. Nothing given: no rows.
One row per source of money the customer gave (own funds, then the loan, grant or investor money): label the source, the amount as typed, and an empty share cell (code computes it).
Nothing: the loan or investor terms, drawn from the facts; none for a grant or the owner’s own plan.

One row per product with both a monthly volume and a price, in the customer’s order: label the product, then the volume and the price as typed, and an empty last cell (code multiplies). A product missing either stays out. A daily volume becomes monthly only when the customer gave the working days, and then both figures stay as typed.
The customer’s monthly cost lines in their order: label the item and the monthly amount as typed. Code adds the total of the lines named.

Only results the customer stated (a monthly revenue, cost or profit, a payback), one row each: label what it is and the figure exactly as typed. Never work one out, never a forecast, NPV, IRR, inflation, tax rate or growth. Nothing stated: no rows.

Three to six rows, each a risk tied to a fact of this plan (the loan, the equipment, staff, raw materials, the sales channel the customer named): label the risk, the measure last, as a plan (rejalashtiriladi) that uses only resources the customer stated. No impact rating, insurer, partner or number.
Two to four sentences: what the project is, what it needs and what it gives (jobs only as the customer stated them), from the figures the customer wrote. No new fact, promise or guarantee.
Only the documents the customer said they will attach, one item each, as named; never a generic checklist.
Nothing: a signature row per signer named (the director by default), ruled blanks for what is missing; none for an own plan.

rules.text: What it is: a business plan for a bank, a grant, an investor or the owner, built from the customer’s message and files. It grows with facts and tables, never with filler: a plan shorter than the pages asked is right when the facts run out.

Register: formal, impersonal, third person (Loyiha ... ko‘zda tutadi, Korxona ... joylashadi); plans in the present or future, never accomplished results; never men, biz or siz; short sentences; no advertising adjective (zamonaviy, noyob, eng yaxshi) unless the customer used it. The plan never speaks about the conversation.

Never invent a person, company, bank, programme, competitor, supplier, address, phone, tax number, date, price, quantity, salary, loan rate or term, market size, statistic, trend, ranking, law, licence, award, risk rating or source. A number appears only as the customer wrote it, a conversion beside it in brackets (3 yil (36 oy)); a range or taxminan is copied as typed.

Never do arithmetic: code computes the amounts, totals and shares of the tables. A sentence that needs a computed figure names the table instead (quyidagi jadvalda), never by a number. Never write a monthly loan payment, a profit, a payback or a cash flow the customer did not state.
A missing fact inside a sentence is a run of underscores; in a table the cell stays empty. A table that would hold only names stays empty, and its part says it in one sentence or is left out.

Write for the purpose: for a loan what it buys, for a grant what it buys and the own contribution, for an investor the ask and the use of funds; an own plan has no loan, investor or signature parts. Name the repayment source only if the customer stated it.

Market and competitors are qualitative and only in the customer’s words; no news, macro background or growth claim. No law, decree, tax rate, subsidy programme or bank product unless the customer named it.

Attached files (a price list, an old plan, quotes) are sources of facts: copy their numbers exactly; take no prose, layout or people’s names from them. Uzbek is Latin only, with ‘ in o‘ and g‘ and ’ for the tutuq belgisi; amounts in the customer’s currency, so‘m when none is named.

Totals (derive): the investment total, the shares of the sources (whole per cents adding to 100), the payroll and revenue products and the cost total are computed from verified numbers of the same table; a row missing an input stays blank and the total is labelled as the items named (Jami (ko‘rsatilgan moddalar)).

Chapter headings are the template’s and numbered by position: Rezyume, Biznes va mahsulot, Bozor va marketing, Operatsion reja va jamoa, Moliyaviy reja, Tavakkalchiliklar va xulosa; a chapter with no content leaves no gap. The cover from 4 pages, the contents from 12.

prompt.uz:
Biznesingizni bitta xabarda yozing: nima qilasiz, qayerda va reja nima uchun kerak (bank krediti, grant, investor yoki o‘zingiz uchun).
Raqamlar (xarajatlar, o‘z mablag‘ingiz, kredit, narxlar) qancha ko‘p bo‘lsa, reja shuncha to‘liq chiqadi. Hajmi aytilmasa — 10 sahifagacha.
Yozmaganingiz bo‘sh chiziq bo‘lib qoladi: raqam, nom, sana va manbani o‘zimdan to‘qimayman. Narxlar ro‘yxati yoki eski rejani PDF, Word yoki TXT qilib qo‘shing.
prompt.ru:
Опишите бизнес одним сообщением: чем занимаетесь, где и для чего нужен план (банковский кредит, грант, инвестор или для себя).
Чем больше цифр (расходы, свои средства, кредит, цены), тем полнее план. Если объём не указан — до 10 страниц.
Что не укажете, останется пустой строкой: цифры, названия, даты и источники я не выдумываю. Прайс-лист или старый план приложите файлом PDF, Word или TXT.
prompt.en:
Describe your business in one message: what you do, where, and what the plan is for (a bank loan, a grant, an investor, or just for yourself).
The more figures you give (costs, own funds, the loan, prices), the fuller the plan. With no length named it runs up to 10 pages.
Anything you leave out stays a blank line: I never make up numbers, names, dates or sources. Attach a price list or an old plan as a PDF, Word or TXT file.

examples.uz: Samarqandda qandolat va non sexi ochmoqchiman, bank krediti uchun biznes-reja kerak, 8 sahifa. Tort, pirog, pechenye va non tayyorlab, kafe va do‘konlarga yetkazaman. Jami 420 mln so‘m kerak: 120 mln o‘zimniki, 300 mln kredit (yillik 24%, 3 yil, 3 oy imtiyozli davr). Sohada 5 yillik tajribam bor. «Namuna Qandolat» MChJ.
examples.ru: Хочу открыть в Самарканде кондитерский и хлебопекарный цех, нужен бизнес-план для банковского кредита, 8 страниц. Буду делать торты, пироги, печенье и хлеб и поставлять в кафе и магазины. Всего нужно 420 млн сум: 120 млн свои, 300 млн кредит (24% годовых, 3 года, 3 месяца льготного периода). В отрасли 5 лет опыта. ООО «Намуна Кондитер».
examples.en: I want to open a confectionery and bakery workshop in Samarkand and need a business plan for a bank loan, 8 pages. I will make cakes, pies, biscuits and bread for cafes and shops. I need 420 million UZS in total: 120 million is my own and 300 million is the loan (24% a year, 3 years, 3 months grace). I have 5 years in the trade. Namuna Confectionery LLC.

examples.uz: Toshkentda IELTS tayyorlov onlayn markazi ochmoqchiman, investor uchun biznes-reja kerak. Dastur va 3 ta o‘qituvchim tayyor, guruhda 12 tadan o‘quvchi, kurs narxi oyiga 600 000 so‘m. Reklama va o‘quv platformasi uchun investordan 150 mln so‘m so‘rayapman.
examples.ru: Хочу открыть в Ташкенте онлайн-центр подготовки к IELTS, нужен бизнес-план для инвестора. Программа и 3 преподавателя уже есть, в группе по 12 учеников, курс стоит 600 000 сум в месяц. Прошу у инвестора 150 млн сум на рекламу и учебную платформу.
examples.en: I plan an online IELTS preparation centre in Tashkent and need a business plan for an investor. The programme and 3 teachers are ready, groups have 12 students and the course costs 600,000 UZS a month. I am asking the investor for 150 million UZS for advertising and the learning platform.

examples.uz: Farg‘onada 20 sotix issiqxona uchun grant arizasiga biznes-reja kerak, 6 sahifa. Pomidor va bodring yetishtirib, mahalliy bozor va do‘konlarga sotaman. Grant 150 mln so‘m, o‘z hissam 50 mln: issiqxona qurilishi 130 mln, sug‘orish tizimi 40 mln, urug‘ va o‘g‘it 30 mln. Narxlarni ilova qilingan ro‘yxatdan oling.
examples.ru: Нужен бизнес-план для заявки на грант: теплица на 20 соток в Фергане, 6 страниц. Буду выращивать помидоры и огурцы и продавать на местном рынке и в магазины. Грант 150 млн сум, свой вклад 50 млн: строительство теплицы 130 млн, система полива 40 млн, семена и удобрения 30 млн. Цены возьмите из прикреплённого прайса.
examples.en: I need a business plan for a grant application: a 20-sotka greenhouse in Fergana, 6 pages. I will grow tomatoes and cucumbers and sell them at the local market and to shops. The grant is 150 million UZS and my own share is 50 million: greenhouse construction 130 million, irrigation system 40 million, seeds and fertiliser 30 million. Please take the prices from the attached price list.

finished.uz: ✅ Reja tayyor. Tavakkalchiliklar jadvalini o‘qib chiqing: uni men taklif qildim. Hisob-kitoblar faqat siz yozgan raqamlardan.
finished.ru: ✅ План готов. Проверьте таблицу рисков: её предложил я. Расчёты сделаны только из ваших цифр.
finished.en: ✅ Your plan is ready. Please read the risk table: it is my suggestion. The calculations use only your figures.

blanks.uz: Ba’zi ma’lumotlar xabaringizda yo‘q edi, shuning uchun bo‘sh chiziq qoldirildi: ularni qo‘lda to‘ldiring yoki raqamlarni yozib, rejani qayta so‘rang.
blanks.ru: Некоторых сведений не было в вашем сообщении, поэтому оставлены пустые линии: заполните их от руки или напишите цифры и запросите план заново.
blanks.en: Some facts were not in your message, so blank lines were left: fill them in by hand, or send the figures and ask for the plan again.

gates: A native Uzbek and a native Russian reader check the chapter and table headings, the key-figure labels and the loan-term rows before the entry is marked ready.

Render the full, blank and long cases in uz, ru and en with the paper sample tool and compare them with units/pdf.biz.biznes_reja/mock/business_biznes_reja.png; check every computed total and share by hand.
The facts corpus is at zero on this entry’s examples.

later.text: The loan repayment schedule (yearly and monthly), the monthly loan payment and the total interest computed from the amount, rate and term: annuity and repayment schedules are deferred.
The monthly profit and the paybacks (simple and with interest) computed across the revenue, cost and loan tables, and the twelve-month cash flow.
The blank guard: asking once instead of delivering when more than six groups of facts are missing.
The delivery line that names each blank, and the line for a plan shorter than asked or capped at 20 pages.
